AEGIS coexists with crosswalk, not replaces — `ASI_CONTROL_MAPPING` stays for scoring math (3 of 4 consumers); crosswalk powers rendering only (1 of 4 — `RemediationRoadmap.tsx:161`) (scratchpad-aegis-integration.md D-05)
Publish to GitHub Packages, not npm Pro or local file: deps — only path that satisfies AEGIS's `frozen-lockfile=true` (scratchpad-aegis-integration.md D-01)
Track B (AEGIS PR1) shipped as local-only prototype branch, not real PR — AEGIS has no git remote
Phase-0 history rewritten to exclude `.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml` from initial commits — OAuth token lacked `workflow` scope; user later refreshed and held-back commit landed as `f6ee490`
Squash-merge all 3 batch PRs (not merge-commit) — clean main history

T10 (orphan check) refined to **key-shape regex** `^(GV|MP|MS|MG)-\d+$`, not usage check — shape was the original bug (`MAP-*` long-form), not unused entries; keeps `MS-4`/`GV-7` (valid-but-unreferenced) passing
`.js` extensions added to `packages/crosswalk/src/index.ts` re-exports — required for nodenext consumers (AEGIS); zero behavioral change for bundler resolution

Renamed package `@obviate/crosswalk` → `@shantanusinghesq/crosswalk` — GitHub Packages npm registry requires the scope to match the GitHub user/org owning the repo; no `obviate` org exists under `shantanusinghesq`
Bypass GH Actions; publish manually with classic PAT — Actions blocked at user-account level, can't fix from harness or quickly
Token type for GH Packages npm = **classic PAT** (`write:packages` scope) — fine-grained PATs do not yet support GitHub Packages npm publishing (documented GitHub limitation)
When/if `obviate` GH org is created, bump version + republish under `@obviate/crosswalk`; AEGIS imports change in one place

Executed entire TRD backlog (`docs/trd/TRD-GAP-REMEDIATION.md`) Waves 1-6, PRs #18-#30 — after the S1-S7 refactor (PRs #9-#17). Package `@shantanusinghesq/crosswalk` v0.2.0→**v0.8.0**; tests 21→**67**.
Honest counts over padded — removed withdrawn SA-12, dropping distinct controls 55→**54** / mappings 90→**89**, rather than substituting a mismatched successor.
Orphans handled non-destructively (user choice) — claim "complete 19"→"**17 of 19 referenced**"; keep GV-3/MS-4 on T16 allowlist; delete stray GV-7.
Fixed systemic GOVERN/MANAGE description-title mismatch (user-approved) — was rendering wrong Evidence-Explorer tooltips (e.g. GV-6→"Resource Allocation").
WS6 YAML migration OUT of scope (user: TS-native). WS7 evidence sourced by web research (user choice) — all 33 refs adversarially verified, **0 unverifiable**.
`validationStatus` on all 80 mappings = `editorial`; ordinal `confidence` left unassigned — no numeric floats, no scrambler-score imports (AD-3).
db/ kept standalone npm island (NOT folded into workspace) so native better-sqlite3 stays out of app CI; enforced by a JSON drift-guard test instead.
Package publish uses `publishConfig` to point the *published* artifact at `dist/`; workspace client keeps consuming raw `src` (no build-before-build coupling).
OSCAL title validation + Tier-2 rationale-cross-reference are **report-only** (editorial debt surfaced, not blocking).

Ran a 3-persona UX audit (OpenAI/clarity, Palo Alto/workflow, Wiz/PLG) of the live app → `docs/UX-AUDIT-2026-07-11.md`. Scores 72/63/61; convergent thesis: "rotate the product 90° — make a **defensible control set** the atomic object; **lead with the evidence** (real incidents), not the map."
Implemented ALL recs across **5 sequenced PRs #31-#35** (each green through ci.yml, squash-merged, live-verified). Package `@shantanusinghesq/crosswalk` v0.8.0→**v0.9.0**; tests **67→107**.

Assessment tray uses **provider-tolerant hooks** — `useAssessment()` throws / `useAssessmentMaybe()` returns null — so `SelectToggle` renders nothing without the provider, keeping `App.smoke` + `RiskDetail.validation` tests byte-identical (verified empty diff every PR).

Committee brief = pure `buildBriefHtml()` → `window.open`+`document.write` of a **self-contained light-theme** doc (dark app theme can't leak); `esc()` on every interpolated value (XSS guard). Not a route/iframe.

Package publish uses **publishConfig** to point the published artifact at `dist`; workspace client keeps consuming raw `src` (no build coupling). Simulator **React.lazy** code-split (main bundle 879→741 KB + 142 KB lazy chunk). Hero image **self-hosted** (`client/public/hero-banner.webp`, dropped CloudFront) + preload.
Governance bridge (ISO 42001 / EU AI Act / SR 11-7) shipped as explicit **editorial v1** (`FRAMEWORK_REFS`), UI-labelled "Editorial v1 · verify before use" — NOT authoritative.
`?risk=ASI0X` permalink additive to frozen `?tab=`; heatmaps severity-ranked (`bySeverity`, `client/src/lib/severity.ts`) with exposure-total columns.

Demo evaluated by **generating real deliverables via the app's pure export fns** (not narration/browser/re-audit) → `docs/scratchpad-demo-evaluate-updated-app.md`. Verdict **PASS**: 5/5 persona jobs now complete end-to-end (were 0/5), 14/14 recs present, 107 tests green.

Total workflow runs ever on this repo: 0. Harness blocked the `gh api PUT actions/permissions/selected-actions` write — user must add via web UI (`/settings/actions` → Allow specific actions → add pattern) or CLI in real terminal

After allowlist fix, re-fire workflow — `git tag -d crosswalk-v0.2.0 && git push origin :refs/tags/crosswalk-v0.2.0 && git tag crosswalk-v0.2.0 && git push origin crosswalk-v0.2.0` (workflow doesn't auto-replay on settings change)
